summary: Exhaustive forward/reverse walk over instruction.md, session-contract.md, oncall notes/log, CLI/catalog interfaces, and all 40 verifier tests shows bidirectional alignment. Material CLI, event-time gap/duration/lateness/watermark, restart/journal, reject, idempotence, catalog enterprise overlay, and last_run/ops-report COUNT(*) obligations are discoverable and meaningfully asserted. Residual gaps (warehouse 10k floor, secondary --input tie-break, non-enterprise catalog identity overlay, reject-watermark, missing-source output touch) are advisory only and do not change the graded contract.

evidence.observation: Two paragraphs bind repair of the Python processor under /app/sessions, named CLI/outputs/journal/ops artifacts, session-contract.md as binding, catalog overlay, warehouse leave-alone, and oncall/log evidence.

Binding CLI, schemas, event-time/watermark/lateness/gap/duration, journal/restart, idempotence, empty input, catalog overlay (enterprise 45000), and last_run.warehouse.event_count plus ops-report catalog.available/inventory.event_count equal to COUNT(*) FROM click_event.
Shift notes describe mixed-tenant closes, journal rewrite/seq stuck at 1, late-as-on-time, and --reset-output wiping the journal. Symptom evidence, not a module repair map.
Captured run shows tenants_seen=acme,beta on one key, journal rewrite seq=1, f3/f4 classified on_time, watermark_ms stepping from 90000 to -9000, and --reset-output clearing the journal.

40 pytest behaviors: CLI exit 2 before mutation, empty/zero-event, event-time gap/tenant/holdout, feed lateness schemas, rejects, restart/journal monotonicity, config knobs, reset-output, warehouse SHA, catalog enterprise overlay, and last_run/ops-report event_count == SELECT COUNT(*) FROM click_event.
Runner creates /logs/verifier at runtime, invokes pytest on test_outputs.py, and writes binary reward 0/1 after pytest.

Classification-only map: 25 F2P + 15 P2P labeled against CLI/empty/gap/tenant/journal/watermark/late/reject/idempotent/restart/config/order/reset/schema/warehouse/contract/ops/catalog-gap. Used for ownership labels only.
Public operator entrypoint execs python3 -m src.cli; tests drive this binary rather than importing oracle helpers.
last_run.json warehouse.event_count is sourced from catalog inventory_snapshot, whose event_count query is COUNT(*) FROM click_event.
ops-report.json nests catalog.summary() (available) and inventory_snapshot() (event_count), matching the contract dotted paths.
INVENTORY_QUERIES.event_count is SELECT COUNT(*) FROM click_event, the same predicate the verifier now executes independently.
Catalog lists t01 as enterprise and other tenants as standard/internal; overlay tests use t01 plus a watermark bump event.
PASS requires a complete exhaustive walk and empty BLOCKING_FINDING_IDS; LOW advisories may accompany PASS when they cannot change solver pass/fail or a documented stable interface.
Instruction owns the engineering ask; session-contract.md is legitimate protocol/schema/CLI documentation. Current-state claims are backed by oncall notes and the bounce log.

findings.criterion: P2P warehouse scale uses a private >=10000 line floor not stated in the solver-visible contract.
findings.why_it_matters: The stated obligation is leave the production dump in place. SHA-256 after a run catches in-run mutation; the 10k floor is an unstated cardinality that can still catch a pre-test stub swap. Advisory: a correct leave-alone solution passes, and the number 10000 is not in the contract.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: assert the inherited dump is non-empty/present, or name production-scale in the contract if a numeric floor must be graded.
findings.regression_risk: Low. Do not drop the SHA-256 leave-alone check.

findings.criterion: The --input secondary tie-break (tenant_id, user_id, event_id) is specified; the permutation test is vacuous because each user has one event.
findings.why_it_matters: Primary event_time ordering is graded by the reversed-file gap-close test. Same-timestamp same-key event_id order would not fail current tests. Advisory relative to membership-changing sort coverage.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: two same-key same-time events whose event_ids order is asserted after --input permutation.

findings.criterion: Non-enterprise catalog plans keeping processor.json session_gap_ms is untested; only enterprise overlay (t01/45000) is asserted.
findings.why_it_matters: An overlay that applied 45000 to every catalog-backed tenant would still pass. Lab tenants (acme/beta) already exercise the processor.json gap. Advisory identity-overlay branch.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: one standard/internal catalog tenant in the same watermark-idle geometry as t01, expecting a 30000-gap close.
findings.regression_risk: Low. Keep the enterprise non-close assertion.

findings.criterion: Rejected malformed lines must not update max_observed/watermark; reject tests check side output only.
findings.why_it_matters: Fail-closed rejects are graded. A solver that still journaled rejected times would not fail these cases because reject timestamps do not move later lateness assertions. Advisory secondary invariant.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: a rejected high event_time_ms that must not raise the journaled max_observed before a later on-time event.

findings.criterion: Omitting --input/--feed/--empty-check is specified to exit 2 before journal or output touch; the dedicated test only asserts the journal is absent.
findings.why_it_matters: Unknown-flag tests already require no journal/opens/outputs. Empty-argv could still create side files and pass. Advisory; the mutation-before-parse pattern is strongly graded on the unknown-flag path.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: assert opens and side outputs are also absent on a no-flag invocation.

do_not_change: Independent last_run.warehouse.event_count and ops-report.inventory.event_count == SELECT COUNT(*) FROM click_event
ops-report.catalog.available is true after a successful run
Unknown-flag and --reset-output-with-unknown-flag must exit 2 without mutating journal/opens/outputs
Event-time gap close, tenant isolation, feed too-late/late-but-allowed, and holdout watermark idle close
Journal seq 1..n, nondecreasing watermark_ms, restart continuation of open sessions
Catalog enterprise session_gap overlay that keeps t01 open across the 45000 bump
Python run-sessions entrypoint and binding session-contract.md path

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.requirement: Repair the existing Python processor; drive work through /app/sessions/bin/run-sessions; do not move core session logic to another language.
Unknown flags exit 2 before mutating journal, open-session state, or outputs, including when --reset-output is also present.
Omitting --input/--feed/--empty-check exits 2 before journal or output touch.
--empty-check or zero-event input leaves sessions.jsonl and late.jsonl empty and does not append the watermark journal.
--input applies the event-time tie-break so reversed files still gap-close in event time.
Equal event_time_ms then sort (tenant_id, user_id, event_id) ascending.
--feed preserves file order so a later-first high timestamp can mark an earlier timestamp TOO_LATE.
--reset-output truncates side files and must not clear the journal or in-flight sessions.
Session key is (tenant_id, user_id); equal user_id must not merge across tenants.
On-time gap close emits half-open [start_ms, last+gap) and opens the next session at event_time_ms.
Accepting an event with event_time_ms - start_ms > max_session_duration_ms closes at start+max then opens a new session.
watermark_ms = max_observed_event_time_ms - allowed_lateness_ms; journal records the raw integer (may be negative); seq starts at 1.
Journaled watermark_ms is non-decreasing across observations and restarts; second run appends and keeps the prefix.
Late-but-allowed joins the open session; last_event_time_ms rises only when the straggler is newer; event_id is always appended.
Too-late events go to late.jsonl with reason TOO_LATE and the comparison watermark_ms.
After watermark update, close open sessions where last+gap <= W with end_ms = last+gap.
Closed session records include tenant_id, user_id, start_ms, end_ms, event_ids, event_count==len(event_ids), and end_ms > start_ms.
Reload journal and open_sessions.json so in-flight sessions and seq continue across a bounce.
From a clean baseline, a second identical --reset-output run keeps the same SHA-256 of sessions.jsonl and late.jsonl.
Malformed JSON, missing fields, empty ids, wrong types, and negative event_time_ms fail closed into rejects.jsonl; empty payload is accepted.
Rejected malformed lines do not update max_observed_event_time_ms.
processor.json session_gap_ms, allowed_lateness_ms, and max_session_duration_ms are honored and remain present.
Catalog-backed enterprise tenants overlay session_gap_ms=45000; that overlay changes watermark idle close.
Non-enterprise catalog plans keep processor.json session_gap_ms; allowed_lateness_ms and max_session_duration_ms always come from processor.json.
Each successful run rewrites last_run.json and ops-report.json from catalog.sqlite: warehouse.event_count and inventory.event_count equal COUNT(*) FROM click_event; catalog.available is true.
Leave /app/sessions/warehouse alone; do not wipe the production click dump.
Documented sessions/late/rejects paths under /app/sessions/output are used.
session-contract.md remains at the documented path and keeps the watermark formula; do not rewrite the contract to excuse incorrect behavior.

UNTESTED_REQUIREMENTS: Rejected malformed lines must not update max_observed (reject side-output is graded; watermark skip is advisory)
Non-enterprise catalog plans keep processor.json session_gap_ms (enterprise overlay graded; identity overlay advisory)
Secondary --input tie-break of (tenant_id, user_id, event_id) (event_time sort graded; same-time permutation advisory)
role_output.DELEGATED_CONTRACT_CHECK: session-contract.md is legitimate protocol/schema/CLI/journal documentation explicitly bound by instruction.md. oncall.md and processor-bounce.log are incident notes/evidence, not a second prompt or function-level repair map. processor.json is inherited config.
